candidates.reason: The whole text stack is pushed into the right half, leaving the left ~40% as dead lime space. The CTA pill sits about 12px from the right edge and its left edge doesn't line up with the centred text above it. The subhead is set almost as large as the headline, which flattens the hierarchy. The original is centred and symmetric, so this layout looks arbitrary rather than intentional.

Everything is crammed into the bottom 40% and the top 60% is empty. The CTA pill nearly touches the bottom edge. Headline, subhead and CTA sit with almost no gaps between them, and the subhead is close to headline size, so the headline doesn't stand out. The canvas looks unbalanced and bottom-heavy.

This keeps the original's centred, balanced composition and hierarchy, so it is the most faithful of the four. But it is essentially a uniform shrink: the subhead (~7px) and the CTA label are too small to read at this size, and there is wide empty space above and below the stack. It needs the type scaled up before it could ship.
